text: The 47th Mechanised Brigade was moved from Zaporizhzhia to Avdiivka in October 2023.
The 47th Mechanised Brigade's M2A2 ODS Bradleys anchored Avdiivka's northern flank around Stepove.
A Russian T-90M "Proryv" attacked near Stepove, where Ukrainian troops held a trench under its tank fire.
The T-90M "Proryv" is Russia's most capable frontline tank.
Two Bradleys took on the T-90M near Stepove, and the T-90M fired first and missed.
The first Bradley's run against the T-90M near Stepove "didn't work out".
The second Bradley's gunner-commander, "Serhiy", closed in on the T-90M with the M242 25 mm cannon and fired armour-piercing rounds into the rear of the tank.
When the armour-piercing rounds gave trouble, Serhiy switched ammunition and shot out the T-90M's optics.
Blinded, the T-90M popped smoke, backed away with its turret spinning and ran into a tree.
The T-90M's crew bailed out, and an FPV drone finished the tank off.
In the Stepove duel the T-90M was mission-killed by 25 mm fire from two Bradleys and then destroyed by an FPV drone.

text: On 10 October 2023 the Russian offensive on Avdiivka began.
On 10–20 October 2023 battalion-size Russian mechanised waves at Avdiivka lost 109 vehicles confirmed by satellite imagery.
On 10–20 October 2023 Russian mechanised waves at Avdiivka lost about 200 vehicles by ground count.
In October 2023 the 47th Mechanised Brigade, with Bradleys and Leopard 2A6s, redeployed from Zaporizhzhia to Avdiivka.
On 10 November 2023 Russian forces entered eastern Stepove.
By 10 November 2023 the field between Stepove and the railway was a kill zone.
On 22 November 2023 video showed a 47th Mechanised Brigade Bradley walking 25 mm fire along a Russian-held treeline in Stepove.
On 22 November 2023 a Bradley-supported Ukrainian counterattack retook positions on the rail line at Stepove.
On 26 November 2023 a 47th Mechanised Brigade video showed Bradleys firing into the treelines Russia used to feed in reinforcements near Avdiivka.
About 5 December 2023 the 67th Mechanised Brigade stormed treeline strongpoints near the Avdiivka coke plant behind Bradleys.
notes: date approximate ('about')

text: On 6 December 2023 Russian Channel 1 showed off an M2A2 ODS Bradley captured near Stepove.
On 7 December 2023, after a failed Russian armoured assault near Avdiivka, a Bradley's machine gun met an infantry-only Russian wave.
By 13 December 2023 (the video date), at night near Stepove, one Bradley hit three MT-LBs in about 30 seconds, with TOW and 25 mm fire according to one account.
In December 2023 the gunner "Serhiy" returned from Bradley training in Germany.
About 27 December 2023 Ukraine counterattacked at Stepove.
notes: date approximate ('about')

text: About 27 December 2023 a Russian reinforced battalion at Stepove lost up to 21 tanks and 14 IFVs/APCs in a day to mines, drones and Bradleys.
notes: 'up to' applies to both figures as written; rests on a single OSINT tally relayed by Forbes (dossier §11)

text: In the Stepove fighting about 27 December 2023 the 47th Mechanised Brigade abandoned 2 Leopards.
On 11 January 2024 (claimed date) a T-90M fought two Bradleys at Stepove and was mission-killed, then finished by an FPV drone.
notes: date is a Telegram channel's claim

text: On 12 January 2024 the 47th Mechanised Brigade's drone video of the Stepove duel went viral.
The 47th Mechanised Brigade captioned its 12 January 2024 Stepove duel video "American equipment won".
About 18 January 2024 a second video of the Stepove duel showed the T-90M's turret spinning, the tank hitting a tree, the crew fleeing and the FPV strike.
notes: date approximate ('about')

text: By 20 January 2024 TSN interviewed the gunner Serhiy and his driver Oleksandr at a roadside repair point in Avdiivka.
About 21 January 2024, near Stepove, a Bradley destroyed a Russian BMP at point-blank range in support of the 109th Territorial Defence Brigade.
notes: date approximate ('about')

text: About 15 February 2024 the 3rd Assault Brigade's Bradleys pushed Russian troops back more than 150 m from Avdiivka's main supply road.
notes: date approximate ('about')

text: On 17 February 2024 Ukraine withdrew from Avdiivka.
On 23 February 2024 possibly the first video of a 47th Mechanised Brigade M1 Abrams in combat appeared, said to be at Stepove.

text: At the Stepove duel site there were trees close enough for the T-90M to hit.
A railway runs past Stepove, and the open field between the village and the rails was a kill zone.
Treelines and concrete walls along the rails north of the Avdiivka coke plant gave Ukraine fire control.
The Avdiivka coke plant covered the northern flank as the "gateway to the city from the northeast".

text: The 47th Separate Mechanised Brigade "Magura" was the main Bradley user, receiving about 190–200 M2s.
The 47th Mechanised Brigade had lost about 30 Bradleys by mid-December 2023.
The 47th Mechanised Brigade had lost at least 31 Bradleys by January 2024.
In late December 2023 the 47th Mechanised Brigade had about a dozen Leopard 2A6s left.
In the Stepove duel the second Bradley was commanded and gunned by "Serhiy", a former infantryman, with driver "Oleksandr", who had driven for a supply unit.
The Stepove duel was Serhiy and Oleksandr's second mission together.
notes: the first Bradley's crew is not identified

text: The 110th and 57th Brigades were in the Avdiivka garrison in late 2023.
The 109th Territorial Defence Brigade's infantry was near Stepove in January 2024.
The 3rd Assault and 67th Mechanised Brigades are also reported using Bradleys at Avdiivka, which contradicts Forbes's description of the 47th as the "sole user".
The Russian tank in the Stepove duel was a single T-90M "Proryv" with a 125 mm gun, about 51 t and a crew of three.
notes: the T-90M's unit is not identified in the sources

text: At Avdiivka two Russian field armies with about 40,000 troops faced about 10,000 Ukrainian defenders.
The Bradley's M242 Bushmaster 25 mm cannon feeds AP (sabot) or HE from two ready boxes, with single or burst fire at about 200 rounds a minute.

observations.subject: ready ammunition boxes on the M242

text: The Bradley's M242 cannon is stabilised, so the reticle stays on target while the hull moves.
The armour experts read the Bradley crew at Stepove as aiming at the T-90M's rear (engine and fuel), then at its sights, for a mission kill.
Doctrine prefers the TOW against tanks, and it is unclear why the Bradley crew at Stepove did not fire one.
In the Stepove duel's paired manoeuvre, one M2 hammered the T-90M as it sped past, and the second, running the other way, took over at close range.
The two Bradleys "trapped" the T-90 between them at Stepove.
A drone observed the Stepove duel, and an FPV drone finished off the abandoned T-90M.
The wider Ukrainian pattern at Stepove was mines laid at night on the approaches, then drones, then Bradleys against whatever got through.
Bradleys at Stepove carried out far ambushes on Russian MT-LB columns.
Bradleys near Avdiivka put machine-gun fire on Russian infantry as it dismounted.
The T-90M in the Stepove duel discharged smoke grenades as a countermeasure.
A Bradley at Stepove used its own smoke while reversing.
Russian forces recovered an abandoned M2 Bradley near Stepove.
In the Stepove duel a T-90M fired on a Ukrainian trench, and the first Bradley's pass failed.
On the second Bradley's run at Stepove, Serhiy says: "We fired with all we could."

cites.quote: We fired with all we could.

text: When the AP rounds gave trouble, Serhiy went for the T-90M's optics: "I started blinding him so he couldn't leave."

cites.quote: I started blinding him so he couldn't leave

text: In the Stepove duel's spin-out the T-90M laid smoke, reversed with its turret spinning and hit a tree; the crew ran and an FPV drone dived on the tank.
At night outside Stepove a Bradley knocked out three MT-LBs in 30 seconds.
notes: dossier offers this as an optional prelude set piece

text: Serhiy's crew decided to commit the second Bradley after the first failed: "There was another crew that came first. It didn't work out, so we had to muster up the courage and go."
